name: Boris Berinsky
original_name: ボリス・ベリンスキー
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Maintenance Chief
Birthplace: Russia (Samara)

An old veteran, he retired from the military before to work in the private sector, but he came back to serve on the Elusion.
He complains a lot, but he's good at looking after people, he's always riding on his pupil Viole to work harder.
